scope: L2CAP: 11 G2 L2C units (ble-l2c, l2c-default, l2c-dm, l2c-hci, l2c-rx, l2c-signaling, l2c-slave) plus L2cDataReq (ble-smp/display_ble_smp_packet_send.c) and L2cSlaveHandlerInit (ble-stack/display_ble_stack_handler_init.c). l2c-log helpers run as stock callees (0x4c9c50 / 0x44b610) rather than as targets.
harness: per-function stub-patch differential (Renode 1.17 Cortex-M55). l2cCb placed at stock 0x200737d8 (0x30), l2cSlaveCb at 0x20073bd8 (0x18). Each side's L2cInit/L2cSlaveInit/L2cMasterInit/L2cSlaveHandlerInit is snapshotted (PREINIT); tests restore that side's snapshot, then randomise identifier/slave rows, packets and ACL headers identically. Stub call arguments compared (arity table, including varargs logs). Function pointers canonicalised (target index or 0xF00F00). WsfMsgDataAlloc returns a scripted pool; DmConnIdByHandle/DmConnRole are scripted 0..3. clang cflags -fno-common -mllvm -arm-global-merge=false on top of sources.json profiles.
